finding: apex-orchestrator.service is OOM-killed at its own 512M cgroup limit roughly every 31 seconds and restarted, continuously, for at least seven days. systemctl reports it 'active/running' between kills, so a liveness check that samples the unit state sees a healthy service.
constraint: CONSTRAINT_MEMCG on /apex.slice/apex-market.slice/apex-orchestrator.service -- the service exceeds its OWN limit. This is not global host pressure and is not caused by research load.

not_caused_by_this_brick.evidence: the kill rate is ~114/hour for every hour of every day in the window, including hours before this brick began at 14:43Z
not_caused_by_this_brick.this_bricks_own_kill: one kill inside wmresearch.slice (the first regression attempt), contained by design; slice oom_kill 4 -> 5

why_it_matters: the orchestrator is the always-on calendar-aware trigger and WORK VERIFIER. A verifier that dies every 31 seconds cannot verify, and the standing law is that heartbeats must measure WORK, not presence. Any Phase-2 commissioning window scheduled through it is unreliable until this is understood.
